# Haris Shakeel

> Haris Shakeel is a software engineer based in Lahore, Pakistan. He builds multi-tenant SaaS platforms, AI agent systems on the Claude Agent SDK and MCP, and production computer-vision pipelines, in Python/FastAPI and TypeScript/Next.js.

- Website: https://www.harisshakeel.site
- Email: harisshakeel061@gmail.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/harisshakeel
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/haris-shakeel-5559852b9
- Education: B.Sc. Computer Science, FAST NUCES Lahore (Dean's Honor List, 6 semesters)

## Experience

- **Software Engineer, Naxtech** (Remote, Feb 2026 – present): built MAVIS for The VA Group, a multi-tenant platform where Claude Code agents do client work with 10,000+ tools across 3,000+ apps and Postgres row-level security as the tenant boundary; and the computer-vision and simulation pipeline for Xision's AI virtual try-on, cutting simulation time from 5 minutes to 30 seconds and generating 3D garments at 90% accuracy against the real ones.
- **Associate Technical Lead, Payback** (Lahore, Mar 2025 – Feb 2026): led payback.pk, a live cashback platform with QR transactions, POS integration and TOTP authentication, deployed on AWS; led a team of 4–5 interns.
- **Associate Software Engineer, Advance Resources** (Lahore, Jan 2024 – Mar 2025): built clusterden.com, a CRM with WhatsApp automation on an action–trigger workflow engine; cut message delivery from 20s to 3s.

## Selected work

- [Xision](https://www.harisshakeel.site/projects/xision): AI virtual try-on, from phone scan to 3D body model to simulated garment fit.
- [MAVIS](https://www.harisshakeel.site/projects/mavis): multi-tenant Claude Code agent platform with MCP tool access and RLS isolation.
- [Metamorphix](https://www.harisshakeel.site/projects/metamorphix): Claude-powered prospect research and CRM outreach pipeline.
- [Sentinel](https://www.harisshakeel.site/projects/sentinel): real-time CCTV incident detection with YOLOv8 and mobile alerts.
- [Clusterden](https://www.harisshakeel.site/projects/clusterden): multi-tenant MERN CRM with real-time collaboration and WhatsApp automation.
- [Payback](https://www.harisshakeel.site/projects/payback): cashback platform with QR and POS transactions.
- More: [Meddo](https://www.harisshakeel.site/projects/meddo), [Comuni](https://www.harisshakeel.site/projects/comuni), [Green n Solar](https://www.harisshakeel.site/projects/green-n-solar), [Dynasty FM](https://www.harisshakeel.site/projects/dynasty), [613 Guys](https://www.harisshakeel.site/projects/613-guys)

## Skills

- Machine learning & computer vision: PyTorch, ONNX Runtime, OpenCV, YOLOv8, MediaPipe, SMPL-X, pose and monocular depth estimation, 3D body modelling, cloth-physics simulation
- LLMs & agentic AI: Claude Agent SDK, MCP, multi-agent orchestration, RAG, structured output, function calling, human-in-the-loop design
- Backend & data: FastAPI, Pydantic, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL (RLS), Prisma, BullMQ, Redis, MongoDB, Supabase
- Frontend & mobile: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, React Native, Flutter
- Infrastructure & testing: Docker, Google Cloud, AWS, Railway, Vercel, GitHub Actions, Sentry, pytest, Playwright
